verified: Three mocked branches plus replay consume one shared468-entry cap; attempt469 is refused before the mock engine body and remains fatal when caught.
Explicit request starts/returns/preview admissions are separate from actual class-dispatched entries; cached-looking/empty/STOP-only zero-entry returns never manufacture cache hits.

Inherited method restoration and a preexisting transparent profiler restore correctly; an independent later arm can start after failure.
Exact deadline distinguishes allowed finalization from forbidden new work; the first representable overrun refuses before entry.
Returned accounting snapshots are detached from retained request/profile state.

static_integration_check.reviewed_sites: The two current inventory branches dynamically dispatch self._engine.preview_stroke; no native geometry was executed by this review.

limits: All tests use mocked preview bodies/clocks. No patient arrays, checkpoints, models, native geometry, training or scientific comparison executed.

The guard covers ordinary dynamic dispatch through the declared engine class, not pre-captured aliases, direct original-function calls, overriding subclasses or other processes. The future runner must preserve this path.
History completion is an explicit caller attestation, not proof of durable complete history. Independent replay/history validation is still required outside the guard.
Timing is cooperative: in-flight C/native work cannot be forcibly interrupted here. External supervision and durable partial receipts remain necessary.
blocked_preview_attempts counts preview-count-ceiling rejections only; deadline/health refusals are represented by separate failure reasons.
The existing whole run_episode includes audit internally. A future integration must separate that audit boundary; simply wrapping the whole function would misstate excluded costs.
